{{Top|canon=Felucian (language)}}
'''Felucianese''' was a guttural, barking [[Language/Legends|language]] of [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia's]] native species, the [[Jungle Felucian/Legends|Felucian]]. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]] was able to understand this language.
